verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an Online Filing Centre and says access requires being a full access manager or filing collaborator, or else holding a corporation key. It never describes the sign-in mechanism itself: no MFA, and no statement on how the corporation key is delivered (remote versus physical mail) or whether in-person or biometric steps are involved. The identity-wall axis applies to a government registry, but there is no evidence of a remotely completable credential-MFA sign-in path.
